ModMetaData.name: Anima Song - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Anima Song, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios listen to the anima tree the Pickle fixture already holds at (70, 132), order colonists to it and press its toggle. Everything they change lives in that loaded save, which is never written back: the toggle scenario saves and reloads on purpose, under its own name.
One scenario reads the modlist to decide what it expects: with Vanilla Races Expanded - Phytokin present the tree must sing its recording and wear its icon, without it Royalty's. That is the only difference between the two passes, and Phytokin is deliberately not declared a dependency here for the same reason Anima Song does not declare it - a pass without it is a pass that has to be possible.
Royalty is required, since the anima tree and the fixture's own tree are Royalty content.
